text:
Hi Mei,

Thanks for your order placed on 2 March. Unfortunately the glaze kiln is down, so we can't ship on March 9 as promised. The new delivery date is 16 March. Invoice 2026-03-02 stays the same.

Best,
Tomas

Hello,

Quick update on PO 1190: everything is on track and will arrive on 2026-03-20 as originally agreed. Our office is closed on 18 March for a holiday.

Regards,
Priya

Hi team,

The courier lost the first pallet. We are re-shipping today; you should have it by April 7 instead of 31 March. Sorry about this. We'll credit the freight on the 15 April statement.

Anna

Dear Mei,

We received your payment, thank you. Delivery is being planned and we'll confirm a date next week.

Kind regards,
Tomas
